description: This file contains implementation details for sparse tensor coalescing using Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) in PyTorch, including functions for computing output positions, marking unique indices, and coalescing sparse tensors on Apple's Metal backend.

methods.name: compute_output_positions
methods.description: Computes the output positions for unique elements in the sparse tensor using Metal shaders.

methods.name: compute_output_positions_parallel
methods.description: Computes output positions in parallel for larger tensors, employing a Kogge-Stone parallel prefix sum algorithm.

methods.name: mark_unique_and_count
methods.description: Marks unique indices and counts the number of unique elements in the tensor indices.

methods.name: _coalesce_sparse_mps
methods.description: Performs coalescing of a sparse tensor on Metal GPU, sorting and merging indices to produce a coalesced sparse tensor.
